excerpt: We present a measurement of the pion form factor based on e+e- annihilation data from the CMD-2 detector in the energy range 0.6<sqrt(s)<1.0 GeV with a systematic uncertainty of 0.8%.
publisher: CMD-2 Collaboration / Phys. Lett. B 648 (2007) 28 / arXiv
title: High-statistics measurement of the pion form factor in the rho-meson energy range with the CMD-2 detector
